worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.summary: Raises a mirror at the target and reflects its type onto itself; whatever type the target currently has, the user becomes.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.use.0: Copy the opponent's type to flip your matchups
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.use.1: Follow an opponent whose type was changed
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.use.2: Take only the primary type and dodge a secondary weakness
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.descriptio: Raises the mirror on a target within %1$s blocks after a %2$s s wind-up; it reads the target's current type.
The reflected type lasts %1$s s; matchups, same-type bonus and type immunities settle on it.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.pair.0: Mirror both: copies the secondary type too, duration ×1.25, cooldown +14 ticks; the closest match.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.pair.1: Primary only: copies the first type, duration ×0.8, cooldown −8 ticks; avoids extra weaknesses from a secondary type.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown shortens again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.reflecttype.preference: On: copies the secondary type too, duration ×1.25, cooldown +14 ticks, the closest match. Off: copies only the first type, duration ×0.8, cooldown −8 ticks, avoiding extra weaknesses from a secondary type.
Only consider mirroring a threat inside this distance; larger mirrors earlier from farther away, smaller only at close range.
On, a holding companion will leave its post to mirror a foe; off, it only casts when already in reach.
